people.name: Ahasuerus
people.line: Persian Emperor (probably Xerxes I); husband of Esther

people.name: Mordecai
people.line: Esther's cousin, a Jewish leader in the Persian court.

translations.web: Mordecai wrote these things, and sent letters to all the Jews who were in all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus, both near and far,
translations.bsb: Mordecai recorded these events and sent letters to all the Jews in all the provinces of King Xerxes, both near and far,
translations.kjv: And Mordecai wrote these things, and sent letters unto all the Jews that were in all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus, both nigh and far,
translations.asv: And Mordecai wrote these things, and sent letters unto all the Jews that were in all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus, both nigh and far,
